checks: FILTER is absent, and separate vertical/horizontal swing actions retain the other direction and keep legacy vertical aliases consistent.
Current settings update their supported special-function values without a page reload.
Control heading and selector use the controller display name while retaining the persisted AC manufacturer.
Plain action feedback keeps backend errors visible and does not apply a failed setting.
Production Control panel preserves custom manufacturer/name, shows normal control labels and sends actual half-degree increments.
Detected exact Fujitsu model changes the existing panel to quarter-degree steps and model-specific functions without reloading.
Fan mode disables temperature adjustments; Cool presets use their own minimum and display their actual setpoints.
A different unknown AC on the same controller does not inherit the previous profile or fabricate controls.
Production dashboard quick adjustment uses the exact model and quarter-degree step, without rounding the existing setpoint.
Initial dashboard cards and in-place name edits use the saved controller display name, hide manufacturer/raw IDs, escape custom text, and retain stable command targets.
